normal.name: Ed Chivers
normal.text: I've almost finished "The Last of Us Part 2" now. I feel like I'm in the many endings of Lord of the Rings right now, but that's ok because despite the horror, saying goodbye to this game is going to be really hard. I became really immersed in its world, and I've really enjoyed seeing the story unfold from different perspectives. I might have a go on the "No Return" option at some point, but I think I'm going to play something less harrowing first. #videogames #TheLastOfUs #tlou2

normal.name: Quester the Quester ⛅
normal.text: #FFIX #VideoGames 2/2 We got to Burmecia where things are very bleak. There are fake chests, mimics, who attack when approached! And another questionably clad character. At first sight I assumed this was a woman based on their clothes. Nope, Kuja is a man. They make a point to point that out in dialogue. I have questions to which I assume are specific answers. I mean the guy takes off on a fluffy and glittery looking dragon!

heated.name: Dave Wilburn
heated.text: What's the best 13" slim Linux laptop these days for a mix of daily driver use, light dev work, and gaming? Must support USB4/TB4. Strong preference for Linux-friendly ethical brands, but those seem few in number these days. My 2019 Razer Blade Stealth 13" finally gave up the ghost. I had hoped to limp along for a few more years and wait out the AI bubble and its ridiculous hardware cost inflations, but alas. #linuxgaming #laptops
